meta.title: Support ADA
meta.description: Support the Asian Doula Alliance, a {taxCode} nonprofit. Gifts fund scholarships, multilingual training and the free public registry.

title: Support ADA
lead: Asian Doula Alliance is a nonprofit. Gifts help candidates pay for training, keep course materials in the languages candidates speak, and keep the public registry free.
taxNote: Gifts are tax-deductible to the fullest extent permitted by U.S. law. Your emailed receipt shows ADA’s legal name, {legalName}, the EIN and the deductible portion of your gift.

give.title: Make a gift
give.body: One-time or recurring gifts in any amount are welcome. You give on ADA’s secure Donorbox page, by card, bank (ACH), Apple Pay or Google Pay.
give.actionLabel: Continue to Donorbox to give (opens donorbox.org in a new tab)
give.newTab: Opens donorbox.org in a new tab.
give.secure: Payment is taken on Donorbox’s secure page. ADA does not store full card numbers.
give.receipt: Your tax receipt is emailed shortly after your gift is processed.

photo.alt: A trainee in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program sits holding a training doll
photo.caption: A trainee practises holding a newborn in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program. {date}.

funds.title: What your gift funds
funds.side: For ADA’s IRS determination letter and financial documents, see Financials.
funds.scholarshipsValue: Need-based and merit-based scholarships that cover partial or full training and exam fees.
funds.materialsValue: Course and exam materials in the languages candidates speak: {languages}. The site itself is in English, <zhHans>简体</zhHans>, <zhHant>繁體</zhHant>, <ja>日本語</ja> and <ko>한국어</ko>.
funds.registryValue: Families, insurers and agencies use it to check a doula’s ADA credential. It needs no account and costs nothing. <registry>Check the registry</registry>

ways.title: Other ways to give
ways.side: Questions about a gift or a receipt? Write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
ways.dafValue: Recommend a grant to {legalName} dba {dba} through your donor-advised fund, using EIN {ein}.
ways.employerValue: Many employers match charitable gifts. Ask your HR team; ADA completes any verification forms your employer requires. <mail>Ask about a match</mail>
